nodes.short_description:
Ein Survival-Horror im Star Trek-Universum mit Body-Tracking. Erkunde ein stark beschädigtes Schiff der Defiant-Klasse und kämpfe gegen eine unbekannte Präsenz, die deinen Körper mutieren lässt.

Stelle dich der Dunkelheit im Schiff... und in deinem Geist.

一款設定於《星際迷航》世界中的全身追蹤敘事生存 VR 體驗。探索一艘被廢棄的挑戰者級別星艦，並和讓你身體變異的未知物體對抗。

對抗星艦和你心神中的黑暗存在。

Star Trek 세계관을 배경으로 펼쳐지는 VR 풀바디 서바이벌 호러 체험입니다. 폐허가 된 디파이언트급 우주 함선을 탐사하며 당신의 몸을 변이시키는 미지의 존재와 맞서 싸우세요.

함선 안에... 그리고 당신의 내면에 도사린 어둠에 맞서세요.

『スター・トレック』の世界で繰り広げられる、全身で体感するVRサバイバルホラー。壊滅状態となったディファイアント級の宇宙艦を舞台に、あなたを変異させる謎の存在と戦おう。

立ち向かうべきは、艦内の闇と…己のこころ。

A VR full-body survival horror experience in the Star Trek universe. Explore a ruined Defiant-class starship as you battle an unknown entity mutating your body.

Confront the darkness within the ship…and your mind.

Pełne doświadczenie survival horroru VR z perspektywy całego ciała, osadzone w uniwersum Star Trek. Eksploruj zniszczony okręt klasy Defiant, stawiając czoła nieznanej istocie, która mutuje twoje ciało.

Zmierz się z ciemnością kryjącą się na statku… i w twoim umyśle.

Une expérience survival-horror en VR intégrale dans l'univers Star Trek. Explorez une épave de vaisseau de classe Defiant tout en luttant contre une entité inconnue qui provoque des mutations de votre corps.

Affrontez les ténèbres du vaisseau... et de votre esprit.

Uma experiência de horror de sobrevivência RV total no universo de Star Trek. Explora a ruína de uma nave da classe Defiant e enfrenta uma entidade misteriosa capaz de alterar o teu próprio corpo.

Enfrenta as trevas na nave... e na tua mente.

Una experiencia de survival horror de realidad virtual de cuerpo completo en el universo de Star Trek. Explora una nave espacial devastada de clase Defiant mientras te enfrentas a una entidad desconocida que está haciendo que tu cuerpo mute.

Enfréntate a la oscuridad de la nave… y de tu mente.

一款設定於《星際迷航》世界中的全身追蹤敘事生存 VR 體驗。探索一艘被廢棄的挑戰者級別星艦，並和讓你身體變異的未知物體對抗。

對抗星艦和你心神中的黑暗存在。

在设定于《星际迷航》世界的叙事生存游戏中获得全身追踪的VR体验。探索一艘被废弃的勇抗级星舰，承受身体的异变并对抗未知物质。

对抗黑暗中的存在，拯救星舰……以及你的心灵。

Una coinvolgente esperienza survival horror in VR ambientata nell'universo di Star Trek. Esplora le rovine di una nave spaziale di classe Defiant mentre combatti contro un'entità sconosciuta che sta mutando il tuo corpo.

Affronta l'oscurità che si annida nella nave... e nella tua mente.

Sobrevivência de terror em realidade virtual dentro do universo de Star Trek. Explore uma espaçonave de classe Defiant enquanto enfrenta uma entidade desconhecida causando mutações no seu corpo.

Confronte a escuridão dentro da nave… e da sua mente.

nodes.long_description:
**A VR full-body narrative survival experience set in the Star Trek universe.**

You’re a Vulcan Starfleet officer, sent on a special mission aboard the U.S.S. Lumen, but something has gone horribly wrong.

There’s no crew in sight, and an unknown entity has infested the ship. Now it’s inside your body, physically mutating you, unlocking dangerous new abilities at the cost of your sanity.
{1789884321884682}Explore the U. S. S. Lumen.
Withstand or embrace the infection inside you.
Confront the darkness within the ship… and your mind.

**Tend to Your VR Body**

Inhabit a full-body avatar. Use your Medical Tricorder to track your condition, treating your infection with a Hypospray, or embracing its mutations.

**Meld With Dangerous DNA**

Manage or exploit your mutation’s side effects to unlock powerful but unstable abilities.

**Face Horrors in Your Mind**

You’re a Vulcan. Rational, disciplined, in control. But your sanity and resolve are faltering. Something aboard is learning your fears and using them against you.

**Set Phasers to Stun & Scan for Life**

Use your Phaser, stealth, or Vulcan nerve pinch to deal with threats. Use your Tricorder to scan for dangers and uncover vital resources.

**Get Your Hands Dirty**

Use your VR hands to interact with the ship, crafting tools and weapons essential for survival.
